capabilities: Convert PNG and JPEG images to WebP locally
Update note references to converted files
Run conversion on a selected note, text selection, or files
Roll back conversions while preserving newer note and image edits
Buy credits and manage a Constance account for billing
extras: Freemium: conversion is local, but the plugin sells credits through the Constance v2 payment service. It sends app usage events to an analytics service and error reports to Datadog, which can include file paths or content from failed operations. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later; the release notes are the main source of feature detail.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to shrink PNG and JPEG images into WebP without breaking the links that embed them.

relations.evidence: Connect your Constance account in plugin settings.

summary: Image converter that turns PNG and JPEG files into WebP locally and updates note references so links keep working.
